Manufactured scarcity worded off a SAVE, not an inquiry. Owner ruling 2026-06-02 (Schedule_Matrix_and_Date_Finder_2026-06-02.md:141 / DECISION_LOG): demand 'starts at the inquiry (Stage 2), NEVER at search (Stage 1) ... counting it as competition = manufactured scarcity (a fineable dark pattern)'. The shipped signal is inquiry-only and floored at MIN_DEMAND_COUPLE_COUNT=3; its one supported phrasing is the measurement itself, 'N couples inquired for your date' (lib/compat-score.ts). Was live on public marketing (studio-card-demo.tsx) and sold to vendors as a feature (vendor-grow-sections.tsx) - both fixed 2026-07-30.

Old name for Alaala, the product's single MEMORY dimension. Owner 2026-07-31: 'the memories hub is still not integrated' / 'ala ala is not fixed'. Two shipped nav surfaces already called the destination Alaala (home-pill-nav.tsx, home-board.tsx) while the page itself, the nav-registry default and the Cmd-K entry still said Memories Hub — the same idea wearing two names. The route /dashboard/library is UNCHANGED; only the surface name is. allow_paths keeps the launcher's historical rename commentary readable (comments are scanned too — this guard matches raw text, not rendered copy).
